s.n: Viktor's cracker sandwiches with hot mustard
s.note: Salted crackers sandwiching smoked cheddar and hot mustard. Viktor lives on crackers and mustard.
s.how: Beat the mustard into the soft butter. Spread half the crackers with the mustard butter and top with cheddar and cornichon. Close with the remaining crackers, pressing so the mustard just squeezes through the holes, and scatter with chives.

s.note: Potato and cheese dumplings with sour cream and onions. A coup in Krakozhia mid-flight.
s.how: Mix the flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt to a soft dough and rest it 15 minutes. Mix the mash with the cheddar and half the onion, fried soft, and season well. Roll the dough thin, cut 8cm rounds, fill and pinch shut. Boil the dumplings until they float, then fry in the butter with the rest of the onion until golden. Serve with sour cream and dill.

m.note: Flame-grilled beef burgers with cheese and pickles, quarters well spent.
m.how: Shape the mince into 4 thin patties a little wider than the buns and season well. Grill over high heat 3 minutes, flip, add the cheese and cook 2 minutes more. Toast the buns and spread with mayo and tomato sauce. Build with lettuce, tomato, the patty, pickles and onion.

m.n: Enrique's catering truck chicken and rice
m.note: Roast chicken thighs and saffron rice with green beans. Enrique trades meals for help with Dolores.
m.how: Rub the chicken with the paprika, garlic, lemon, oil and salt. Roast skin-side up at 210C until crisp and cooked through. While it roasts, soften the onion, stir in the rice and saffron, add the stock and simmer, covered, until tender. Steam the beans for the last 5 minutes and serve everything together, airline tray style.

w.n: Great Day in Harlem New York cheesecake
w.note: Baked New York cheesecake with sour cherries, saved for last.
w.how: Mix the crumbs and butter and press into a lined 22cm springform tin. Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest. Pour over the base and bake at 150C until just set with a wobble in the middle, then cool in the turned-off oven. Simmer the cherry juice with the cornflour until glossy, stir in the cherries and spoon over the chilled cake.
shop: 680g jar pitted sour cherries, drained, 125ml juice kept@Pantry

d.note: Strong cold brew over sweetened condensed milk and ice. Viktor tells Dolores she is a stallion.
d.how: Spoon the condensed milk into 4 tall glasses and fill with ice. Pour over the cold brew, then the milk, and dust with cinnamon. Stir at the table.
